question: The famous musician, Faiyaz Khan is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Faiyaz Khan:-**

 
 
• Ustad Faiyaz Khan (1880–1950) was one of the most influential Indian classical vocalists of the first half of the 20th century.
 
• He is often regarded as the last great singer of the Agra Gharana, a school of Hindustani classical music.
 
• Ustad Faiyaz Khan was born in Sikandra near Agra.
 
• Even though he belonged to the Agra Gharana, his style was a blend of many schools of Indian classical music, including the styles of Jaipur and Gwalior Gharanas.
 
• He was known for his exceptional voice and a unique style of presentation.
 
• **He is associated with Tabla.**
